description: Count the words in a text.
name: example.word_count

description:
Fetch a URL (following redirects) and return its content as text: HTML pages as markdown of the
main content, plain text and JSON as they are, other types (PDF, images, ...) as metadata only.
`raw` returns HTML source instead of markdown. Long content is cut at `max_chars`; read on with
`offset`. The result has the final URL and the HTTP status (error pages are returned, not raised).
Maintained in the monorepo (tools/web/); if it breaks, fix it.
name: web.fetch

description:
Search the web. Returns {backend, cost_usd, note, results: [{title, url, snippet}]}; use web.fetch
to read a result. `backend`: "openrouter" (OpenRouter's web search, about $0.001 per search),
"duckduckgo" (free scraping, often blocked by its bot check), or "auto" (default): OpenRouter, and
DuckDuckGo if that fails; `note` says why a backend was skipped. `region` is a DuckDuckGo region
code such as "us-en" or "de-de"; OpenRouter ignores it. Maintained in the monorepo (tools/web/);
if it breaks, fix it.
name: web.search
